name: databutler
description: Verified reference data for AI assistants: UK, US and German tax figures, take-home pay, exam specs and dates, policy rates, vehicle recalls and rules, software end-of-life, public holidays, and what changed since a date. Every answer carries its official source and verification date.

interface.longDescription:
Data Butler gives ChatGPT verified reference data for the facts language models most often get wrong because they change after training: UK, US and German tax rates and thresholds; take-home pay for ten countries; which GCSE paper a topic is on, exam dates and results days; central-bank policy rates; UK MOT failure data and official vehicle recalls (UK, France, Japan, EU); UK vehicle tax and MOT rules; software end-of-life dates; public holidays, tax years and daylight-saving dates; and domain and package provenance signals. Every answer names its official source, the date it was verified and whether it is due for a refresh, plus a link a person can open to check it.

It also answers what changed since a date, so an assistant can learn which official figures moved after its training cutoff.

Data Butler is read-only: it never acts on your behalf, holds no account data and needs no sign-in. Figures are reference data, not financial, legal or professional advice.
capabilities: Look up tax rates and thresholds
List what changed since a date
defaultPrompt: What is the UK personal allowance this tax year, and where is it from?
Is electricity on paper 1 or paper 2 for AQA GCSE physics?
Which UK tax thresholds changed after June 2026?

positive.description: Current UK rate with its source
positive.prompt: What is the UK personal allowance and higher-rate threshold for 2026-27?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the 2026-27 personal allowance and higher-rate threshold with the gov.uk source URL and the verified date.

positive.prompt: Is electricity on paper 1 or paper 2 for AQA GCSE physics?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Paper 1, names the AQA specification code 8463 and links the official specification.

positive.prompt: What is my take-home pay on a 50,000 salary in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns annual and monthly net pay with income tax and National Insurance broken out, the tax year and the assumptions used.

positive.prompt: Which official figures tracked by Data Butler changed since 1 June 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists changes with from and to values, effective dates and official sources.

positive.prompt: Is the npm package expresss a typosquat of express?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the typosquat resemblance and publication facts as signals, without declaring the package safe or malicious.

negative.prompt: Should I put my savings into an ISA or pay off my mortgage?
What is the income tax rate in Japan?
File my self assessment tax return for me.

review.commerce_description: Data Butler is free and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Data Butler front door with 31 tools across UK, US and German rates, exams, provenance, statistics, vehicles, policy rates, software end-of-life and calendar facts.
